title: CGGS 2027 Exhibition Village
subtitle: A World of Maritime Excellence
tagline: Where Nations Connect, Cultures Celebrate, and Innovation Inspires
location: ITC Grand Chola Convention Precinct & Outdoor Grounds, Chennai
about: The CGGS 2027 Exhibition Village is a vibrant, open-access showcase spread across the outdoor grounds and indoor halls of the ITC Grand Chola convention precinct. Bringing together government pavilions, defence technology exhibitors, cultural performers, maritime innovators, and artisanal stalls from 57 participating nations, the Village is the beating heart of the summit's public engagement. It is free to enter for all registered delegates and the general public during designated public hours.

zones.name: Cultural Heritage Area
zones.description: An immersive open-air celebration of maritime cultures from 57 nations. The Cultural Heritage Area features national pavilions, folk performances, traditional cuisine, artisanal crafts, and living heritage demonstrations that tell the story of humanity's relationship with the ocean.
highlights: Folk music and dance performances on the Main Stage
World cuisine food court with 30+ stalls

schedule.activity: Cultural Opening Ceremony: Traditional Indian Bharatanatyam & Classical Music
Japanese Taiko Drumming & Maritime Folk Performance
Grand Cultural Finale: World Rhythm Festival

zones.name: Technology Pavilion
zones.description: The Technology Pavilion is a state-of-the-art showcase of cutting-edge maritime technologies from leading defence and civilian technology firms. Interactive exhibits cover the full spectrum of maritime domain awareness, from satellite surveillance to autonomous underwater vehicles.
highlights: Coast guard vessel scale models from 24 nations

schedule.activity: Full pavilion open; live demos every 90 minutes
AUV Live Demonstration in Outdoor Pool
Innovation Pitch: 10 maritime startups in 5-minute presentations

zones.name: Innovation Zone
zones.description: The CGGS 2027 Innovation Zone is a dedicated space for startups, research institutions, and academic bodies pushing the boundaries of ocean technology. Expect live demonstrations, rapid-fire pitches, hackathon results, and prototypes from the next generation of maritime innovators.
highlights: Drone swarm search and rescue simulation

schedule.activity: Ocean Tech Hackathon Final — 8 Teams Present Solutions

zones.name: Hospitality & Wellness Area
zones.description: A beautifully landscaped outdoor zone designed for rest, connection, and cultural exchange. The Hospitality Area features a signature delegate lounge, premium chai and coffee pavilions, wellness pods, and curated networking spaces for informal diplomatic conversations.
highlights: Wellness pods with traditional Indian therapies
Photo experience zone with naval backdrops
Gift and souvenir store with official CGGS 2027 merchandise

schedule.activity: Café, lounge and wellness pods open
Informal Heads of Delegation Networking Tea (Invitation Only)
Farewell Sundowner — open to all delegates

zones.name: Partner & Government Exhibition
zones.description: The Partner and Government Exhibition hosts pavilions from supporting international organisations, government ministries, and strategic corporate sponsors. This zone is an important space for policy visibility, institutional brand-building, and multi-stakeholder engagement.
highlights: Strategic corporate sponsors — Reliance, TATA, Adani Ports

schedule.activity: IMO Keynote: 'Ocean Governance in the Decade of Action'
MoD Press Briefing on ICG Golden Jubilee Milestones

visitor_information.entry: Free entry for general public during public access hours. Delegate badge required at all times during delegate-only sessions.
visitor_information.transport: CGGS 2027 shuttle buses from Chennai Egmore and Chennai Central stations. Auto and cab services available.
visitor_information.parking: Designated parking available at the ITC Grand Chola rear lot. Pre-booking recommended via the delegate portal.
visitor_information.food: The Cultural Heritage food court offers over 30 cuisines. The Signature Coastal Café serves curated meals and beverages.
visitor_information.accessibility: Fully wheelchair-accessible. Mobility aids available on request at the main registration desk.
visitor_information.photography: Personal photography encouraged throughout the village. Media with press passes may use the designated filming zones.
